title: Blaming the Blameless: data, figures and replication
description: The manuscript of "Blaming the Blameless: Language Models Endorse Reasonable Care but Enforce Strict Causal Blame", the derived data behind every figure and table, the scripts that redraw them, the pre-registrations, the adapters' corpus, recipe and manifests, and the replication material, including the later readings with every call as logged. The paper and data are CC BY 4.0; the scripts are Apache-2.0 (see LICENSES.md).
